Name: GET_CUSTOM_SAVE_DATA_INT
Description: Returns the value of a saved byte, short, or int made by Custom Save Data Framework.

Parameters.Name: modId
Parameters.Description: ID of a mod as seen in its ModConfig.json.

Parameters.Name: key
Parameters.Description: Key of a saved value as defined by the mod passed to modId.

Name: GET_CUSTOM_SAVE_DATA_FLOAT

Parameters.Name: modId
Parameters.Description: ID of a mod as seen in its ModConfig.json.

Parameters.Name: key
Parameters.Description: Key of a saved value as defined by the mod passed to modId.

Name: SET_CUSTOM_SAVE_DATA_INT
Description: Modifies a value of integral type made by Custom Save Data Framework. Returns 1 if the operation succeeded.

Parameters.Name: modId
Parameters.Description: ID of a mod as seen in its ModConfig.json.

Parameters.Name: key
Parameters.Description: Key of a saved value as defined by the mod passed to modId.

Parameters.Name: value
Parameters.Description: The new value of the field being written to.

Name: CREATE_CUSTOM_SAVE_DATA_INT
Description: Creates a Custom Save Data Framework object of int type.

Parameters.Name: modId
Parameters.Description: ID of a mod as seen in its ModConfig.json.

Parameters.Name: key
Parameters.Description: Key of a saved value as defined by the mod passed to modId.

Parameters.Name: value
Parameters.Description: The default value of the field being created.

Parameters.Name: unusedDataPolicy
Parameters.Description: Whether to discard this object if a save file is loaded with its associated mod disabled. 0 to keep, 1 to discard.

Name: CUSTOM_SAVE_ENTRY_EXISTS
Description: Returns 1 if a Custom Save Data Framework entry matching the specified mod id and key exists, 0 otherwise.

Parameters.Description: ID of a mod as seen in its ModConfig.json.
